column3: #2652 closed: LocalStorage.CreateDynamicSecretLease inserts an active lease and re-reads its config (still enabled) FOR SHARE in one transaction, rolling back with ErrDynamicSecretConfigDisabled if it was disabled; IssueLease then revokes the just-minted credential (cleanupOrphanedRole). DeleteProject's #369 cascade UPDATEs (locks) the config row and lists leases to revoke only after commit, so it either sees the lease or the lease fails closed. Proven: TestCTAReview_IssueLease_vs_DeleteProject_CrossReplicaPostgres, TestCTAReview_IssueLease_DeleteProjectAfterInsert_CrossReplicaPostgres, TestCreateDynamicSecretLease_ActiveRefusedOnDisabledConfig.
